subject: GCP private offer — commit redistribution & staging plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stratify.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-sales@google.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer: commit phasing & early drawdown option

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — Stratify (we use Nimbus internally for this pilot) is excited about a private offer. Our procurement lead asked a few specific things before we proceed:

- Can we structure the committed spend so that up to 30% can be frontloaded for an accelerated Q3 pilot?
- If we need to move budget between SKUs (e.g., inference vs embeddings), what is the earliest we can reallocate without breaking the PO?
- Pricing team wants a simple drawdown schedule and a single invoice cadence (monthly).

I attached the draft private offer we got from GCP (Nimbus_Private_Offer_v2.pdf) — it lists SKUs at line level. If possible, would love a short plan that shows: a) how we might phase drawdowns across quarters, and b) any operational caveats for co-sell credits.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Stratify
elena.rossi@stratify.ai
+1 415-555-0163

Attachments: Nimbus_Private_Offer_v2.pdf (pdf, 1 page stub)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stratify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: commit phasing & early drawdown option

Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Quick reply to confirm we can support a frontload option; we just need to coordinate with the Marketplace team on how SKUs are mapped for invoicing and co-sell attribution.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Quick 30-minute call tomorrow to align on SKUs + frontload percentage (I can include Marketplace sales).
2) We’ll produce a short phasing plan (spreadsheet) showing a few options: conservative (even quartering), pilot-frontloaded (30% Q1), and flexible reallocation (policy notes).
3) If that looks good, we’ll produce a DocuSign-ready PO and call out invoice cadence (monthly) and reallocation windows.

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in to draft the phasing matrix and confirm any SKU-level constraints we need to surface for procurement.

Available slots: Thu 6/11 9–11am PT or Thu 6/11 2–4pm PT. Elena — which works for you?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: GCP private offer: commit phasing & early drawdown option

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 11:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Karthik — looping you in to draft the phasing matrix and confirm any SKU-level constraints we need to surface for procurement.

Team — draft plan below (high level). I attached the phasing spreadsheet (commit_phasing_matrix.xlsx) with SKU rows and three scenario columns. Notes:

- SKU mapping: GCP will invoice by marketplace SKU; we should align Redwoods' internal product line to each SKU line so that customers can reallocate within a mapped group only.
- Recommended phasing (pilot-forward option): Q3 = 40% (pilot + ramp), Q4 = 30%, Q1 2027 = 20%, Q2 2027 = 10%. This lets Nimbus frontload more than the 30% requested if they want quicker capacity.
- Reallocation window: allow a 30-day reallocation window per quarter up to 10% movement between mapped SKU groups without PO amendment. Anything larger requires a PO addendum and GCP Marketplace consent.
- Co-sell crediting: notify co-sell ops at drawdown milestone triggers (we should provide a simple webhook feed or CSV weekly).
- Invoicing: monthly consolidated invoice preferred; engineering/ops should confirm SKU consumption tagging.

Open questions for legal/procurement: is the 30-day reallocation policy acceptable, and can GCP sign off on the frontload >30% exception in the PO?

Attachments: commit_phasing_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet stub)

Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stratify.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: commit phasing & early drawdown option

Thanks — Thu 6/11 2–4pm PT worked for our internal folks and the call was helpful. We are comfortable with the proposed pilot-forward numbers (the 40/30/20/10 split) but procurement needs confirmation on two items:

1) Invoice delivery and remit details — they want one monthly consolidated invoice addressed to Nimbus with line-level consumption details.
2) DocuSign: we prefer the PO to be DocuSigned with the frontload clause explicit. Our procurement contact is procurement@nimbusanalytics.com (cc'ed).

I’ve uploaded the updated PO to our side — see attached (Nimbus_Private_Offer_v2.pdf). If you and your team can produce a short note confirming the reallocation window and the invoice cadence, we will route to legal and sign.

Best,
Elena

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stratify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-sales@google.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer: commit phasing & early drawdown option — next steps

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for getting procurement involved. Summary and action items below so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary decisions
- Phasing scenario: pilot-forward accepted (40% Q3, 30% Q4, 20% Q1 2027, 10% Q2 2027).
- Frontload: we will allow the 40% pilot-forward; Redwood will document the exception in the PO and Marketplace will acknowledge SKU mapping.
- Reallocation: 30-day window per quarter, up to 10% movement between mapped SKU groups without PO amendment; larger changes require PO addendum and Marketplace approval.
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoice to Nimbus with line-level usage detail; remit details to match the PO.

Action items (owners / ETA)
- Marissa: finalize commit_phasing_matrix.xlsx and upload to the shared drive (ETA: 6/16 EOD). Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-commit-phasing
- Karthik: coordinate with GCP Marketplace sales to confirm SKU mapping and acceptance of frontload clause (ETA: 6/18).
- Soojin: draft the one-paragraph confirmation for procurement / DocuSign that calls out the reallocation window and invoice cadence (attached to PO) (ETA: 6/15 EOD).
- Elena / Nimbus procurement: route DocuSign once you receive the PO addendum note.

I’ve attached the draft confirmation below to paste into the PO before DocuSign: 

"Redwood Inference confirms that the PO permits a frontload of committed spend per the pilot-forward phasing (40% in initial quarter). Reallocation between mapped SKU groups is permitted up to 10% per quarter during a 30-day reallocation window without requiring a PO amendment. Monthly consolidated invoicing with line-level usage details will be provided by Redwood."

Attachments: commit_phasing_matrix.xlsx, Nimbus_Private_Offer_v2.pdf

If anyone needs the DocuSign template, I can create the envelope and pre-fill signers once Karthik confirms SKU mapping.

Thanks all — see you on the follow-ups.

Soojin
